summary.text: Aaron Guckian is the Republican nominee for governor. A former Rhode Island Dental Association leader, teacher and banker, he was a special assistant to Gov. Don Carcieri and was the 2022 Republican nominee for lieutenant governor. He campaigns on lowering taxes and fees, opposing a millionaire's tax and truck tolls, and working with the Trump administration.

paragraphs.text: East Greenwich native and former college basketball player; holds two master's degrees; has worked as a teacher and in banking and nonprofit work.
Served as a special assistant to Gov. Don Carcieri about two decades ago and most recently led the Rhode Island Dental Association.
Was the 2022 Republican nominee for lieutenant governor, losing to Democrat Sabina Matos.
